description: Runway provides task-based APIs for video, image, audio, upscaling, and real-time media models, including Runway and selected third-party models.
prompt_training_notes: Runway's API terms and privacy policy govern submitted data; the public API documentation does not advertise a zero-data-retention mode or selectable processing region.
regional_pricing_notes: Runway publishes one USD credit schedule; credits cost $0.01, with sales tax potentially added based on location.

sources.notes: Complete current model inventory and modalities.
Task endpoints, exact identifiers, parameters, lifecycle, and input limits.
Current credit prices and billing dimensions.
Per-organization modality concurrency and daily generation limits.

verification.notes: Reconciled 30 current model identifiers across video, image, upscaling, audio, and real-time APIs, plus retired Gen-3 Alpha Turbo, Gen-4 Aleph, and legacy Upscale V1 history. The available-model guide includes gemini_image3.1_flash but the current official pricing table omits it, so no price is fabricated.
